name: EH3D-ISOCAM
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: a library and a command line that read the copper of a Gerber layer (with the reader of EH3D-CORE-LIBS and the shapes of EH3D-GERBERVIEWER), draw it on a fine grid, work out the exact distance from every point to the copper and trace the paths of the tool at its radius (plus a stepover for each further pass) as closed polylines, report where two pieces of copper are closer than the tool is wide and write the paths as G-code. No window, no Voronoi or rubout and nothing has been milled.
